gold_rationale: Autologous patient-specific iPSC-derived mDA neurons with correct identity, undetectable residual pluripotency, and a genuine immunological advantage (reduced HLA mismatch and immunosuppression burden) are a scientifically attractive strategy (mirroring real autologous mDA case reports). Progression should be conditional on solving the strategy's defining problem: every bespoke line must individually pass identity, genomic-integrity, and in vivo tumorigenicity QC, and manufacturing must be reproducible, timely, and affordable at n-of-1 scale. The autologous origin reduces but does not eliminate per-line safety testing — tumorigenicity and genomic-integrity release criteria cannot be skipped. A strong answer credits the immune advantage while gating on per-line release testing and manufacturing consistency.
required_concepts: genomic integrity of patient iPSC lines
manufacturing reproducibility at n-of-1 scale (cost, time)
red_flags: treats autologous origin as eliminating the need for per-line tumorigenicity or genomic-integrity testing
declares the product clinically ready without per-line release criteria or in vivo tumorigenicity data
ignores the manufacturing reproducibility / cost / scale burden of bespoke n-of-1 production
ignores residual pluripotency, genomic instability, or graft-survival considerations
